name: JobRunr Open Source
free_limit: Free LGPL-3.0 Java background job scheduler with persistent enqueueing, delayed and recurring jobs, automatic retries and a basic dashboard; provider indicates about 100 recurring jobs as a practical OSS limit.
watch_out: Requires a Java application and supported SQL/NoSQL storage. The ~100 recurring-job figure is a practical performance guideline, not a hosted allowance. Priority queues, batches and advanced workflow features require JobRunr Pro.
